body:
I think even as a first step we don't want users to do their own mapping between the InstantSearch search state and the helper/client one.

I think what we need is a way to perform the search before any rendering.

Also if have a props to set the results state then we need a way to get him back (could be useful for some others use cases). But what I have in mind is more a results state that will be already formatted according to widgets (like the search state). Basically, a way to get back all the provided props of connectors.
